$comment: Curated candidate URLs for manufacturers that do not publish board design files on GitHub. Issue #28 section 10 ranks the official product page and official documentation above a repository, but neither is machine-enumerable: raspberrypi.com answers an automated client with a Cloudflare interstitial, and st.com does not answer one at all. So a human supplies candidate URLs from the official source and verify.py decides availability from the retrieved bytes, exactly as it does for a GitHub tree. Nothing here asserts that a file exists.
